sql-formatter.name: SQL Formatter
sql-formatter.description: Format or compact SQL locally while preserving strings and comments.

meta.title: SQL Formatter and Minifier
meta.description: Format SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite with configurable indentation and keyword casing.
meta.keywords: SQL formatter, SQL minifier, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite

sql-formatter.hint: Comments and literal content are preserved. Formatting does not check database semantics.

text-batch-processor.name: Text Batch Processor
text-batch-processor.description: Clean, deduplicate, sort and combine lines with composable transformations.

meta.title: Text Batch Processor and SQL IN Builder
meta.description: Normalize line endings, trim, remove duplicates, sort Unicode text and build quoted SQL IN lists locally.
meta.keywords: text processing, deduplicate lines, sort lines, SQL IN

text-batch-processor.hint: Order: normalize line endings, trim, remove blanks, deduplicate, sort, add prefix/suffix, then join. SQL mode doubles apostrophes.
text-batch-processor.sqlUnsafe: SQL lists cannot contain backslashes or null characters. Remove them or use normal text output.

string-escape.name: String Escape and Unescape
string-escape.description: Encode and decode JSON strings, Unicode escapes, HTML entities and nested JSON strings.

meta.title: String Escape and Unescape Tool
meta.description: Escape JSON, Unicode and HTML text or decode nested JSON strings locally with a depth limit.
meta.keywords: string escape, unescape, Unicode, HTML entities, nested JSON

string-escape.invalidJson: Invalid JSON. Enter a valid quoted JSON string.
string-escape.invalidUnicode: Invalid Unicode escape. Use four hexadecimal digits after \u.
string-escape.stringRequired: The JSON value must be a string, enclosed in double quotes.
string-escape.depthError: Decoding depth exceeded or invalid. Choose a whole number from 1 to 20.
string-escape.jsonHint: Encoding adds JSON quotes. Decoding requires a quoted string and preserves all whitespace.
string-escape.unicodeHint: Encoding escapes every UTF-16 unit. Emoji use surrogate pairs; decoding also preserves unescaped text.
string-escape.htmlHint: Decode named and numeric HTML entities. Results are displayed as plain text.
string-escape.nestedHint: Repeatedly decode JSON strings until text or a JSON value is reached, up to the depth limit.

jsonpath-query.name: JSONPath Query
jsonpath-query.description: Explore nested JSON with paths, wildcards and safe comparison filters.

meta.title: JSONPath Query and Filter Tool
meta.description: Query JSON locally using JSONPath, safe filters and optional matching paths. Export results as JSON.
meta.keywords: JSONPath query, JSON filter, JSON paths, JSON search

jsonpath-query.hint: Use $.store.books[*].title or [?(@.price < 10)]. Filters support comparisons, &&, || and !; function calls are disabled.
jsonpath-query.invalidJson: Invalid JSON input. Check the document syntax.
jsonpath-query.unsafe: Unsafe expression rejected. Use property lookups, comparisons and boolean operators only.
jsonpath-query.limit: Query limit exceeded: at most 1,000,000 input characters, 50,000 values, 64 nesting levels and 2,000 path characters.
